sql.propToolInverter.getAllForCompany: select i.id, i.inverter_name, i.brand, i.inverter_type, i.company_id, i.active, i.archived, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(inverterStates))) FROM ( SELECT ist.id, ist.inverter_id as "inverterId", s.state, ist.company_state_id as "companyStateId", ist.adder_amount as "adderAmount", ist.archived FROM props.inverter_state ist inner join flow.company_state cs on cs.id = ist.company_state_id inner join flow.state s on s.id = cs.state_id WHERE ist.inverter_id = i.id and ist.archived is not true) inverterStates), '[]') AS "inverterStates" from props.inverter i where i.company_id = :companyId and i.archived is not true order by i.inverter_name
sql.propToolInverter.getOne: select *, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(inverterStates))) FROM ( SELECT ist.id, ist.inverter_id as "inverterId", s.state, ist.company_state_id as "companyStateId", ist.adder_amount as "adderAmount", ist.archived FROM props.inverter_state ist inner join flow.company_state cs on cs.id = ist.company_state_id inner join flow.state s on s.id = cs.state_id WHERE ist.inverter_id = i.id and ist.archived is not true) inverterStates), '[]') AS "inverterStates" from props.inverter i where id = :id
sql.propToolInverter.insert: insert into props.inverter(inverter_name, brand, inverter_type, company_id, active, created_by_id) values (:inverterName, :brand, :inverterType, :companyId, :active, :createdById)
sql.propToolInverter.update: update props.inverter set inverter_name = :inverterName, brand = :brand, inverter_type = :inverterType, active = :active, date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :modifiedById where id = :id
sql.propToolInverter.delete: update props.inverter set archived = true, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.propToolInverter.insertStates: insert into props.inverter_state(inverter_id, company_state_id, adder_amount, created_by_id) values (:inverterId, :companyStateId, :adderAmount, :createdById)
sql.propToolInverter.updateState: update props.inverter_state set adder_amount = :adderAmount, date_modified = now(), archived = :archived where id = :inverterStateId
